title: Dying Light 2 Stay Human
shortDescription: Dying Light 2 Stay Human helps define a Nintendo Switch action and horror and survival path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced action and horror and survival option to the Nintendo Switch discovery path.
Keeps the external item link distinct from the deterministic catalog method.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Listed for the Nintendo Switch action and horror and survival discovery path using a linked structured-data reference; this remains a catalog record, never an aggregate score.
